## Summary

Describe the user-facing or maintenance change.

## Testing

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage` when backend behavior changes
- [ ] `cd frontend && npm test -- --watchAll=false` when frontend behavior changes
- [ ] `cd frontend && npm run lint` when frontend code changes

## Checklist

- [ ] The branch is based on `develop`.
- [ ] The commit messages use the conventional commit format.
- [ ] No secrets, build output, or generated coverage files are included.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when needed.
